levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عبد الوهاب
أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد الصادق

notes: Route 1: the Sadiq (named after «عن») narrates «خرجت أنا وأبي»; the father speaks inside the story, so he is the last link (narrated encounter, owner ruling 5), surface as the text names him
Route 2 («وقد حدثني ... عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام (مثله)») is a second isnad after the saying, read as its own route, not a variant; the text notes its own wording is shorter
The Imam «أبي عبد الله» after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «بإسناد يرفعه» is an unnamed gap (rule 8)
